extra_vocab.en: a large room in a hospital where patients stay
extra_vocab.note: ward 在多益最常見於醫院情境，指有多張病床的病房區，如 maternity ward（產房）；城市介紹或新聞中也可指市內的行政區。

example.en: The hospital opened two new wards for patients last month.
example.zh: 這家醫院上個月為病患開設了兩間新病房。

example.en: Visitors must wash their hands before entering a hospital ward.
example.zh: 訪客進入醫院病房前必須先洗手。

example.en: She works as a nurse in the maternity ward.
example.zh: 她在產科病房擔任護理師。

example.en: A famous singer visited the children's ward on Sunday.
example.zh: 一位知名歌手週日探訪了兒童病房。

examples.en: The nurse checks every patient in the ward twice a day.
examples.zh: 護理師每天檢查病房裡的每位病人兩次。

examples.en: Visiting hours for the surgery ward start at two p.m.
examples.zh: 外科病房的探病時間從下午兩點開始。

examples.en: The new clinic will serve more than ten thousand people in our ward.
examples.zh: 這間新診所將服務我們行政區內一萬多人。

confusable.diff: word 是「單字」，拼法只差一個字母，發音也不同（/wɜːrd/）。

example.en: Please check every word in the report before sending it.
example.zh: 寄出前請檢查報告裡的每一個單字。

confusable.diff: award 是「獎；頒獎」，字尾也是 -ward，但意思完全不同。

example.en: The company won an award for its new product.
example.zh: 這間公司的新產品獲得了一個獎項。

similar.diff: room 是一般的房間；ward 是醫院裡有多張病床的大病房。

example.en: The patient was moved to a private room yesterday.
example.zh: 病人昨天被轉到了單人病房。

example.en: The hospital is open to patients all day.
example.zh: 這家醫院全天候接待病人。

example.en: A nurse will bring your medicine to the room soon.
example.zh: 護理師很快就會把你的藥送來。

example.en: Each patient receives a card with a room number.
example.zh: 每位病人都會拿到一張寫有房號的卡片。

senses.en: a part of a hospital where patients stay

example.en: The patient was moved to the surgery ward this morning.
example.zh: 病人今天早上被轉到外科病房。

senses.en: one of the areas a city is divided into
senses.distinguish: 和 city、vote、council 等字一起出現時，指城市的行政區。

example.en: Each ward in the city elects one member to the council.
example.zh: 市內每個行政區選出一位議員進入市議會。

extra_vocab.en: a chair with wheels for a person who cannot walk easily
extra_vocab.note: wheelchair 是輪椅，多益常見於無障礙設施、醫院與公共場所的公告，如 wheelchair access（輪椅可通行）、wheelchair ramp（輪椅坡道）。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: 「坐在輪椅上」介系詞用 in：in a wheelchair；不說 on a wheelchair。

example.en: The hospital lends wheelchairs to visitors free of charge.
example.zh: 醫院免費借輪椅給訪客使用。

example.en: The new office building has full wheelchair access.
example.zh: 這棟新辦公大樓有完整的輪椅通行設施。

example.en: A wheelchair ramp was built beside the main entrance.
example.zh: 大門旁邊蓋了一條輪椅坡道。

example.en: Each wheelchair user can enter through the side door.
example.zh: 每位輪椅使用者都可以從側門進入。

examples.en: Please keep this area clear for people in a wheelchair.
examples.zh: 請保持這個區域暢通，供坐輪椅的人使用。

examples.en: Our hotel can provide a wheelchair on request at the front desk.
examples.zh: 我們的飯店可依需求在櫃檯提供輪椅。

examples.en: A staff member pushed the patient out in a wheelchair.
examples.zh: 一位工作人員用輪椅推著病人出去。

example.en: Use the ramp on the left side of the building.
example.zh: 請使用大樓左側的坡道。

example.en: The elevator is next to the front desk.
example.zh: 電梯就在櫃檯旁邊。

example.en: All rooms in the hotel are accessible by elevator.
example.zh: 飯店所有房間都可以搭電梯抵達。

extra_vocab.en: any person who; no matter who
extra_vocab.note: whoever 用來指「不論是誰」，常出現在公告、規定與電子郵件，如 Whoever is responsible...。語氣比 anyone who 稍微正式。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: whoever 引導名詞子句，在子句中當主詞，後面直接接動詞：Whoever calls first... 的 whoever 不能換成 whomever，除非它是子句中的受詞。

example.en: Whoever is responsible for the error must tell the manager.
example.zh: 不論是誰造成這個錯誤，都必須告訴經理。

example.en: Whoever wants to join the trip should sign up today.
example.zh: 任何想參加旅行的人，今天就要報名。

example.en: Seats are given to whoever comes first at the door.
example.zh: 座位會給先到門口的人。

examples.en: Whoever finds the missing key should call the front desk.
examples.zh: 不論誰找到遺失的鑰匙，都請打電話給櫃檯。

examples.en: Please send this file to whoever needs it for the project.
examples.zh: 請把這個檔案寄給任何專案中需要它的人。

examples.en: We will choose whoever has the best plan for the budget.
examples.zh: 我們會選擇預算計畫最好的人。

confusable.diff: whomever 是 whoever 的受格，只用在子句裡當受詞，較正式，口語很少用。
confusable.usage: whoever 在子句中當主詞；whomever 在子句中當受詞，如 You may invite whomever you like.

example.en: You may invite whomever you like to the company dinner.
example.zh: 你可以邀請任何你喜歡的人參加公司晚宴。

similar.diff: anyone who 意思相同但是兩個字，口語常用；whoever 更簡短，語氣稍正式。

example.en: Anyone who needs help can ask the staff at the desk.
example.zh: 任何需要幫忙的人都可以詢問櫃檯的工作人員。

example.en: Whatever you decide, please tell us by Friday.
example.zh: 不論你怎麼決定，請在週五前告訴我們。

example.en: Call me whenever you have a question about the order.
example.zh: 不論何時你對訂單有問題，都請打給我。

example.en: You can work wherever you have a stable internet connection.
example.zh: 只要網路穩定，你在哪裡都可以工作。

extra_vocab.en: the soft thick hair of sheep, used to make clothes
extra_vocab.note: wool 是羊毛，多益常見於服飾店、產品介紹與採購的情境，如 wool coat、100% wool，也常出現在洗滌標示。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: wool 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不說 a wool；放在名詞前可直接當修飾語：a wool coat。

example.en: This wool coat is on sale for half price today.
example.zh: 這件羊毛大衣今天半價特價。

example.en: All of our scarves are made of pure wool.
example.zh: 我們所有的圍巾都是純羊毛製成的。

example.en: Customers like our wool sweaters because they keep them warm.
example.zh: 顧客喜歡我們的羊毛毛衣，因為很保暖。

examples.en: These socks are made of soft wool and cotton.
examples.zh: 這些襪子是用柔軟的羊毛和棉製成的。

examples.en: Wash wool clothes by hand in cold water.
examples.zh: 羊毛衣物請用冷水手洗。

examples.en: We import wool from Australia for our winter products.
examples.zh: 我們從澳洲進口羊毛來製作冬季商品。

confusable.diff: wood 是木頭，發音（/wʊd/）和 wool 很接近，要看字尾 d 和 l 分辨。

example.en: The desk is made of wood, not metal.
example.zh: 這張桌子是木頭做的，不是金屬。

example.en: This shirt is made of soft cotton from our own farm.
example.zh: 這件襯衫是用柔軟的棉製成的。

example.en: The company sells silk ties and scarves online.
example.zh: 這間公司在網路上販售絲質領帶和圍巾。

example.en: We chose a strong fabric for the uniforms.
example.zh: 我們為制服選了耐用的布料。

derived.link: wool + -en，用某種材料做的，像 wooden（木製的）、golden（金色的）

extra_vocab.en: a small line or fold in skin or cloth
extra_vocab.note: wrinkle 的 w 不發音。多益常見於衣物、洗衣與保養品的情境，如 wrinkle-free shirts（免燙襯衫）；動詞也可指「使起皺」。

example.en: This cream can reduce wrinkles around your eyes in a month.
example.zh: 這款乳霜可以在一個月內減少你眼周的皺紋。

example.en: The long trip wrinkled my suit and my shirt.
example.zh: 長途旅行把我的西裝和襯衫都弄皺了。

example.en: Please do not wear a wrinkled shirt to the interview.
example.zh: 面試時請不要穿皺掉的襯衫。

example.en: Fold the clothes carefully to avoid wrinkling them in the bag.
example.zh: 請小心折衣服，避免它們在袋子裡起皺。

example.en: These wrinkle-free shirts are popular with business travelers.
example.zh: 這些免燙襯衫很受商務旅客歡迎。

example.en: The hotel can iron out wrinkles in your suit.
example.zh: 飯店可以幫你把西裝的皺褶燙平。

example.en: The store sells wrinkle cream made from natural ingredients.
example.zh: 這家店販售天然成分製成的抗皺乳霜。

examples.en: Hang the dress right away to prevent a wrinkle.
examples.zh: 請立刻把洋裝掛起來，以免起皺。

examples.en: The ad says the cream makes every wrinkle less visible.
examples.zh: 廣告說這款乳霜讓每一條皺紋都不那麼明顯。

examples.en: I found a wrinkle on my jacket right before the meeting.
examples.zh: 我在會議前才發現外套上有一處皺褶。

similar.diff: crease 指衣服或紙被折出的線條，可以是刻意的；wrinkle 通常是不整齊的皺紋。

example.en: The tailor pressed a sharp crease into the pants.
example.zh: 裁縫師把褲子燙出了一條清楚的褲線。

example.en: Please iron my shirt before the meeting tomorrow.
example.zh: 請在明天的會議前幫我燙好襯衫。

example.en: This fabric does not wrinkle easily when it is washed.
example.zh: 這種布料洗過後不容易起皺。

example.en: There is a small wrinkle on the front of the tablecloth.
example.zh: 桌巾的正面有一處小皺褶。

example.en: Do not sit on the dress, or it may wrinkle.
example.zh: 不要坐在洋裝上，否則它可能會起皺。

senses.en: a line on the skin of the face

example.en: The company sells products that reduce wrinkles on the face.
example.zh: 這間公司販售能減少臉上皺紋的產品。

senses.en: a fold or line in cloth or paper
senses.distinguish: 和 shirt、dress、cloth、iron 等字一起出現時，指衣物的皺褶。

example.en: The steam machine removes every wrinkle from the curtains.
example.zh: 蒸氣機能去除窗簾上的每一處皺褶。

extra_vocab.en: the feeling that you are ready and happy to do something
extra_vocab.note: willingness 表示「願意做某事的態度」，多益常見於求職信、面試、員工評語與談判情境，如 willingness to learn（願意學習）。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: willingness 後面接 to + 原形動詞：willingness to work late；表示「某人的意願」時可用 one's willingness。

example.en: Her willingness to learn impressed the whole training team.
example.zh: 她願意學習的態度讓整個訓練團隊印象深刻。

example.en: Both companies showed willingness to sign the agreement soon.
example.zh: 兩家公司都表現出盡快簽署協議的意願。

example.en: The manager worried about the team's lack of willingness to change.
example.zh: 經理擔心團隊缺乏改變的意願。

examples.en: I am writing to show my willingness to join your company.
examples.zh: 我寫這封信是想表達我願意加入貴公司。

examples.en: The interviewer asked about our willingness to travel abroad.
examples.zh: 面試官問了我們是否願意出國出差。

examples.en: Thank you for your willingness to work with us on this project.
examples.zh: 感謝你願意與我們合作這個專案。

similar.diff: eagerness 是「很期待、很熱切」，比 willingness 的「願意」更強烈。

example.en: His eagerness to start the project made everyone smile.
example.zh: 他迫不及待想開始這個專案，讓大家都笑了。

example.en: A positive attitude is important for every sales team.
example.zh: 正面的態度對每個業務團隊都很重要。

example.en: We appreciate your effort on the new campaign.
example.zh: 我們很感謝你在新的行銷活動上的努力。

derived.link: will（意願）+ -ing，變成形容詞；willingness 就是 willing + -ness

extra_vocab.en: a small clock that you wear on your wrist
extra_vocab.note: wristwatch 是手錶，wrist 的 w 不發音。多益常見於商品介紹、百貨公司與失物招領的情境，口語常簡稱 watch。

example.en: The shop sells wristwatches for both men and women.
example.zh: 這家店販售男女都適用的手錶。

example.en: Our manager always wears a wristwatch to every meeting.
example.zh: 我們的經理每次開會都戴著手錶。

example.en: This digital wristwatch also records your daily steps.
example.zh: 這支電子手錶還能記錄你每天的步數。

example.en: The wristwatch strap broke, so I bought a new one.
example.zh: 錶帶斷了，所以我買了一條新的。

examples.en: This wristwatch is waterproof and works for up to three years.
examples.zh: 這支手錶防水，而且能使用長達三年。

examples.en: A silver wristwatch was found in the meeting room today.
examples.zh: 今天在會議室裡找到一支銀色手錶。

examples.en: The company gave each retiring worker a wristwatch as a gift.
examples.zh: 公司送給每位退休員工一支手錶當作禮物。

similar.diff: watch 是口語常用的簡稱，也可當動詞「看」；wristwatch 明確指戴在手腕上的錶。

example.en: I left my watch on the desk this morning.
example.zh: 我今天早上把手錶忘在桌上了。

example.en: The clock on the wall is five minutes late.
example.zh: 牆上的時鐘慢了五分鐘。

example.en: I set the alarm for six before my trip.
example.zh: 出差前我把鬧鐘設在六點。

extra_vocab.en: the state of being healthy in your body and mind
extra_vocab.note: wellness 強調身心都健康的生活方式，多益常見於企業福利、健身中心與保健產品的情境，如 employee wellness program（員工健康計畫）。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: wellness 是不可數名詞，不加 s，前面也不加 a。

example.en: Our wellness program offers free yoga classes every Wednesday.
example.zh: 我們的健康計畫每週三提供免費瑜伽課。

example.en: The new wellness center opens on the third floor.
example.zh: 新的健康中心將在三樓開幕。

example.en: She works in the health and wellness industry.
example.zh: 她在健康保健產業工作。

examples.en: The company cares about the wellness of its employees.
examples.zh: 公司很關心員工的身心健康。

examples.en: This tea is a simple way to support your wellness every day.
examples.zh: 這款茶是每天維護身心健康的簡單方法。

examples.en: Join our wellness day to learn about healthy food and sleep.
examples.zh: 歡迎參加我們的健康日，了解健康飲食和睡眠。

confusable.diff: illness 是「疾病」，字尾也是 -ness，但意思和 wellness 相反。

example.en: A long illness kept him away from work for a month.
example.zh: 一場長期的疾病讓他一個月沒辦法上班。

similar.diff: health 是一般的健康狀態；wellness 更強調主動維持身心良好的生活方式。

example.en: Regular exercise is good for your health and your mood.
example.zh: 規律運動對你的健康和心情都有好處。

example.en: The hotel has a fitness room open all night.
example.zh: 這間飯店有一間整晚開放的健身房。

example.en: Staff can take a short exercise break at noon.
example.zh: 員工可以在中午做一小段運動休息。

derived.link: 最基礎的字，well 當形容詞指身體健康，wellness 是 well + -ness
